name: video-play
description: A video camera with a solid play triangle.
useCase: Start a video preview or camera feed.
misuse: Name the control for the video action it performs; do not rely on color alone to indicate recording.

16.reason: The complete camera body and lens surround a separate solid control mark inside the shared square frame.

24.reason: The camera outline matches its family while open spaces keep each control mark clear at toolbar sizes.
